translations.text: And Enoch answered and said—a righteous man from God, whose eyes were open and who saw a vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me: “I heard everything from them, and I understood what I saw, not for this generation, but for the distant generations that are to come.”
Then they all swore together and bound themselves to one another by a curse concerning it.

They were two hundred in all, and they descended onto Ardis, which is the summit of Mount Hermon. They called the mountain Hermon because they swore there and bound themselves to one another by a curse.

And all the others with them took wives for themselves. Each chose one for himself, and they began to go in to them and unite with them. They taught them sorcery and spells and the cutting of roots, and they made them familiar with plants.
As people were being destroyed, the people cried out, and their voice reached heaven.
And Semjaza taught spells, he to whom you gave authority to rule over those who were together with him.
And now teach him how to escape, so that his descendants may remain throughout the earth.
And now all the righteous will escape and remain alive until they father a thousand, and they will complete all the days of their youth and their old age in peace.
Then I went and told them all together, and they were all afraid; fear and trembling seized them.
This is the book of the word of righteousness and the rebuke of the eternal Watchers, as the Holy and Great One commanded in that vision.
Your petition for yourselves will not be granted, nor will your petition for them. And you, while weeping and lamenting, will not utter even a single word from the book that I wrote for you.
I entered that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice. There was no pleasure or life within it. Fear covered me, and trembling seized me.
For this reason I gave them wives, so that they might sow their seed in them and children might be born through them, so that work might be carried out on the earth.
But you were originally spiritual beings, living an eternal life that does not die through all the generations of the world.

Evil spirits came out of their flesh, because they were created from above; their origin and first foundation were from the holy Watchers. They will be evil spirits on the earth, and they will be called evil spirits.
The one toward the east was of colored stone, and one was of stone of the sea, and another was of healing stone; the one toward the south was of red stone.
Then I said, “For what sin have they been bound, and why have they been left here?”
And Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me, “Enoch, why do you ask, and about whom do you inquire and laugh?”
From there I saw another place toward the west, extending to the ends of the earth.
Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “This course that you saw toward the west is the fire that burns all the lights of heaven.”
From there I went to another place on the earth, and he showed me a mountain of fire that blazed day and night.
Then Michael, one of the holy and honored angels who was with me and was in charge of them, answered me.

Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “This valley is cursed for those who are cursed forever. Here all those who speak improper words against the Lord with their mouths and say outrageous things about his glory will be gathered. Here they will gather them, and here will be their judgment.”
There I saw trees of judgment, very fragrant incense, frankincense and myrrh; and the trees were not alike.
And I saw a beautiful tree, and its fragrance was like that of mastic.
And to the east of these beasts I saw the ends of the earth, where heaven rests, and open gates.
And from there I went northward to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious wonder at the ends of the whole earth.
It is better to speak of these earlier things, but we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom from those who come later.
And before him there is no end. Before the world was created, he knows what the world is and what will happen from generation to generation.
And I heard the voices of those four faces as they praised the Lord of Spirits.
And I heard the second voice blessing the Chosen One and the chosen ones who depend on the Lord of Spirits.

And he said to me, “This first voice is the merciful and patient holy Michael. The second, who is over every illness and every wound of humanity, is Raphael. The third, who is over every power, is holy Gabriel. And the fourth, who is over repentance and the hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel.”
And after this I saw all the secrets of the heavens, how the kingdom is divided, and how human deeds are weighed in a balance.
And Wisdom went out to dwell among human beings, but she found no dwelling place. Wisdom returned to her place and settled among the angels.
And I will transform the dry land and make it a blessing, and I will settle my chosen ones within it. But those who commit sin and wrongdoing will not walk within it.
And in those days the prayer of the righteous rose up, and the blood of the righteous was called to account before the Lord of Spirits.
And before the sun and the signs were created, and before the stars of heaven were made, his name was called before the Lord of Spirits.

And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits revealed him to the righteous and the chosen, for he preserved the portion of the righteous. For they hated and rejected this world of injustice, and they hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits. For in his name they are saved, and he became the avenger of their lives.
And in those days a change will take place for the holy and the chosen. The light of days will dwell upon them, and glory and honor will return to the holy.
And he is righteous in his judgment and in the presence of his glory. Injustice will not stand at his judgment, and whoever does not repent before him will perish.
And in those days the mountains will dance like rams and leap like lambs full of milk, and they will all become angels in heaven.
And after those days, in that place where I saw all the secret visions, I was carried away in a whirlwind, and they took me to the west.

And these mountains that you saw—the mountain of iron, the mountain of copper, the mountain of silver, the mountain of gold, the mountain of tin, and the mountain of lead—will all be like wax before a fire in the presence of the Chosen One, and like water flowing down from above upon those mountains. And they will become powerless beneath his feet.
And because of this they recognized the injustice they committed on the earth, and because of this they will perish.
And in those days Sheol will open its mouth, and they will sink into it. And Sheol will swallow the sinners, destroying them, from before the chosen ones.
And they will all fall down and worship the Lord of Spirits. And this is the end of the second parable.

And the spirit of dew has its dwelling at the ends of heaven, and it is connected with the storehouses of rain. Its course is in winter and summer, and its cloud and the cloud of mist are joined together, and one gives to the other.

And these measurements will reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, so that those who perished in the wilderness and those who were devoured by the fish of the sea and by wild beasts may return and stand firm on the day of the Chosen One. For no one perishes before the Lord of Spirits, and no one can perish.
For the Son of Man was hidden from the beginning, and the Most High kept him in the presence of his power and revealed him to the chosen ones.

And in those days the mighty kings who possess the earth will plead with the angels of his punishment, to whom they have been handed over, to give them a little rest, so that they may fall down and worship before the Lord of Spirits and confess their sins before him.
And Enoch came from [?] and stood beside me and said to me, “Why have you cried out to me with a bitter cry and weeping?”

And he will establish your name among the holy ones and preserve you among those who dwell on dry land. He will establish your descendants in righteousness for kingship and great glory. From your descendants will come a fountain of righteous and holy people, and they will be countless forever.

And when all this happened, from those drops of fire and the disturbance that shook them in that place, a smell of sulfur arose and mingled with those waters. And that valley of the angels who led others astray burns beneath that land.
And after this, judgment will terrify them and make them tremble, because they showed this to those who dwell on dry land.

And here are the names of those angels; these are their names: the first of them, Semyaza; the second, Arstiqifa; the third, Armen; the fourth, Kokabiel; the fifth, Turiel; the sixth, Rumyal; the seventh, Daniel; the eighth, Nuqael; the ninth, Baraqiel; the tenth, Azazel; the eleventh, Armaros; the twelfth, Bataryal; the thirteenth, Basasael; the fourteenth, Ananel; the fifteenth, Turyal; the sixteenth, Simasipiel; the seventeenth, Yetariel; the eighteenth, Tumael; the nineteenth, Tarel; the twentieth, Rumael; the twenty-first, Azazel.

And the third was named Gadreel. He was the one who showed deadly blows to human beings. He led Eve astray, and he showed human beings the instruments of death: the shield, armor, the sword for killing, and all the instruments of death.
And from his hand they went out against those who dwell on dry land, from that time and forever.
And he sat on the throne of his glory, and all judgment was entrusted to him, the Son of Man. He will remove and destroy sinners from the face of the earth, and those who led the world astray.
And Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, and Phanuel came out of that house, along with countless holy angels.

The book of the movements of the lights of heaven, each according to its group, each according to its authority and its season, each according to its name, its origin, and its month, which Uriel, the holy angel who was with me and who is their guide, showed me; and their entire account, as he showed it to me, for all the years of the world and forever, until a new work is made that will last forever.
And on that day, daylight becomes longer than night, and daylight becomes twice as long as night. Daylight becomes twelve parts, and night becomes shorter and amounts to six parts.
And when thirty mornings have been completed, daylight decreases by exactly one part. Daylight becomes eleven parts, and night seven parts.
And the sun leaves the west through that sixth gate and travels east. It rises through the fifth gate for thirty mornings and sets in the west again through the fifth western gate.
And on that day, daylight decreases by two parts. Daylight becomes ten parts, and night eight parts.
And on that day, night becomes eleven parts, and daylight seven parts.

And on that day, the sun comes out through that second gate and sets in the west. It returns east and rises through the third gate for thirty-one mornings, because of its sign, and sets in the west of heaven.

It rises for seven days, makes its circuit, and returns again through the gate through which the sun rises. There it completes all its light, and it draws away from the sun. For eight days it enters through the sixth gate, from which the sun rises.
And during those days of five years, thirty days accrue to the sun. All the days that accrue to one year out of those five years, when complete, amount to three hundred and sixty-four days.

And the moon brings the years exactly into order. All of them, according to their positions, are neither a day early nor a day late, but they change the year with exact accuracy, each consisting of three hundred and sixty-four days.

For three years, its days are one thousand and ninety-two; and for five years, its days are one thousand eight hundred and twenty, so that for eight years there are two thousand nine hundred and twelve days.

From four of them come winds of blessing and peace, and from those eight come winds of punishment. When they are sent out, they destroy the whole earth, the water upon it, all who dwell upon it, and everything that is in the water and on dry land.
In the sun’s disk there are seven portions of light in excess of the moon’s. It is imparted in measured amounts until the seventh portion of the sun has passed.

In those days the angel Uriel answered me and said to me, “Look, Enoch, I have shown you everything and revealed everything to you, so that you may see this sun, this moon, those who lead the stars of heaven, and all those who bring them back—their workings, their seasons, and their appearances.”
The moon will change its order and will not appear at its appointed time.
Let your heart be strong, for the good will make righteousness known to the good. The righteous will rejoice with the righteous, and they will congratulate one another.
Because of them people go astray and do not include them in the reckoning of the whole course of time, for people misunderstand them and do not know them accurately.

For they belong in the reckoning of the year and are truly assigned forever: one in the first gate, one in the third gate, one in the fourth gate, and one in the sixth gate. The year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.
From there I arose, prayed, and made supplication. I wrote down my prayer for the generations forever, and I have shown you everything, my son Methuselah.

When I went out below, I saw the sky, the sun rising in the east, the moon descending in the west, a few stars, the whole earth, and everything he had known before. I blessed the Lord of judgment and gave him glory, because he brought the sun out through the windows of the east, made it rise and shine across the face of heaven, and it rose and traveled the path shown to it.

That white bull which had become a man came out of that vessel, with three bulls beside him. One of those three bulls was white, resembling that bull; one of them was red like blood, and one was black. That white bull departed from them.

They began to produce wild animals and birds. From them came a mixture of all kinds: lions, leopards, wolves, dogs, hyenas, wild boars, foxes, squirrels, pigs, falcons, eagles, vultures, kites, [?], and ravens. A white bull was born among them.
They began to bite one another. That white bull which had been born among them fathered a wild donkey and a white bull along with it, and the wild donkeys multiplied.
That latter ram arose and led the young sheep. This latter ram fathered many sheep and lay down. A young sheep became a ram in his place and became ruler and leader of those sheep.
He abandoned them into the hands of lions, leopards, wolves, and hyenas, into the hands of foxes, and to all the wild animals. Those wild animals began to tear those sheep apart.

In this way, in the vision, I saw the one who wrote, how he recorded each one destroyed by those shepherds every day. He went up, rested, and showed the entire book to the Lord of the sheep: everything they had done, everything each of them had destroyed, and everything they had handed over to destruction.

Everything will be handed over along with the nations, and the storehouse will burn with fire. They will drive them out of the whole earth, and they will be thrown into the judgment of fire and destroyed in wrath and in a mighty judgment that lasts forever.
After this, in the tenth week, in its seventh part, there will be eternal judgment, and it will be carried out against the Watchers, and a great eternal heaven that springs up among the angels [?].
After this there will be many weeks, beyond counting, forever in goodness and righteousness. From then on, sin will never again be spoken of.

What was written by Enoch. Enoch, praised by all people and ruler of the whole earth, wrote all this instruction in wisdom for all my children who dwell on earth and for the later generations who practice uprightness and peace.
Sin will be destroyed in darkness forever, and from that day onward it will never again be seen.
At its completion, the chosen righteous ones from the eternal plant of righteousness will be rewarded. They will be given sevenfold instruction concerning all his creation.

Woe to those who build their houses through sin, for they will be uprooted from all their foundations and will fall by the sword. Those who acquire gold and silver will quickly be destroyed in judgment.
Do not be like them. Rather, this statement will be a witness against them: “You have become partners with sinners.”
Woe to you who acquire silver and gold unrighteously and say, “We have become wealthy, we have possessions, and we have acquired everything we wanted.”

Woe to you who love acts of injustice! Why do you hope for good for yourselves? Know that you are to be handed over into the hands of the righteous. They will cut your necks and kill you, and they will not show you mercy.
In those days, in one place, fathers and their children will strike one another, and brothers will fall dead with their companions, until their blood flows like a river.

He will appoint guards from among the holy angels over all the righteous and holy ones, and they will guard them like the pupil of an eye until all evil and all sin come to an end. Even if the righteous sleep, they will sleep a long sleep, and they will have nothing to fear.
He will make every cloud, mist, dew, and rain testify against you, for they are all being withheld from you so that they do not descend upon you, and they will not take your sins into account.

Do not say to the righteous and good who are alive, “In the days of our labor we have toiled painfully, seen every hardship, and encountered many evils. We have been brought to an end and reduced in number, and our spirit has grown weak.”

His flesh was white like snow and red like a rose. The hair of his head and his locks were like white wool, and his eyes were beautiful. When he opened his eyes, he lit up the whole house like the sun, and the entire house shone even more brightly.

I, Enoch, answered concerning him and said to him, “The Lord will bring about new things on earth and will act. And this [?] I went out and saw in a vision, and I made it known to you, for the household of the son of Jared, my father, [?] transgressed the word of the Lord from the height of heaven.”
This is the son who has been born to you. He will remain on earth, and his three sons will be saved with him. When all the people on earth die, he and his sons will be saved.
They will father offspring on earth who grow large, not of spirit but of flesh. A great punishment will come upon the earth, and the earth will be washed clean of all corruption.
Which you have committed. You will remain during these days until those who do evil come to an end and the power of the sinners comes to an end.

He said to me, “This place that you see is where the spirits of sinners and the condemned will be placed, along with those who commit sin and those who distort everything that God has spoken through the mouths of his prophets who are active on earth.”
